svg.title: SMAART Admin setup flow
svg.desc: Who does what first in the Admin dashboard — Super Admin configures platform, Consultant onboards colleges, College Admin creates accounts

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about Super Admin platform configuration in SMAART')
sendPrompt('What does Super Admin do in question bank setup?')
sendPrompt('How does Super Admin create courses in SMAART?')
sendPrompt('What AI integrations does SMAART Super Admin configure?')
sendPrompt('What escalation rules does Super Admin set?')
sendPrompt('How does a Consultant onboard a new college in SMAART?')
sendPrompt('What data is captured in SMAART college identity tab?')
sendPrompt('What compliance documents are required in SMAART onboarding?')
sendPrompt('How is a college activated in SMAART?')
sendPrompt('How does a College Admin create student accounts in SMAART?')
sendPrompt('How do students receive their SMAART login credentials?')
sendPrompt('What can the College Admin monitor on the dashboard?')

svg.text: Sequence: Super Admin first → Consultant second → College Admin third
